#!/bin/bash
# System Backup Automation Script
BACKUP_DIR="/var/backups/$(date +%Y%m%d)"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
tar -czf "$BACKUP_DIR/app.tar.gz" /var/www/app

data.label: Containers & Docker
data.description: Package applications into lightweight, reproducible OCI container images. Master Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and Docker Compose.
data.codeSnippet:
# Multi-stage Dockerfile for Node.js App
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
CMD ["node", "dist/main.js"]

data.label: Kubernetes Orchestration
data.description: Orchestrate container clusters at scale. Understand Deployments, Pods, Services, Ingress controllers, Helm charts, and HPA autoscaling.
data.codeSnippet:
# Kubernetes Deployment Manifest
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web-api
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web-api
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web-api
        image: registry.example.com/api:v1.2.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080

data.label: CI/CD GitHub Actions
data.description: Automate linting, testing, Docker image building, security scanning, and zero-downtime deployment pipelines.
data.codeSnippet:
# GitHub Actions CI Workflow
name: Build & Test
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - run: npm ci
    - run: npm test
    - run: npx tsc --noEmit
